title: Concept: GraphQL error returning the whole query
description: An error object that repeats the submitted query text in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The echoed query shows the resolver path and the variables, which tells an attacker how errors differ between existing and missing records.
applicability: Deployments that render an error object that repeats the submitted query text into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The echoed query shows the resolver path and the variables, which tells an attacker how errors differ between existing and missing records.
